review.source_and_reason: Exact POMALIDOMIDE on both NOC 15139 and 30153 with POMALYST reference and RID submission 165891. Pomalyst SPL lists active-moiety UNII D2UX06XLB5.
Glatiramer acetate is a heterogeneous synthetic polypeptide. Pharmaceutical-class sensitivity retains it.
Exact RIVAROXABAN on NOC 9785 and same-day ANDS group with XARELTO reference and RID submission 119111. Xarelto SPL lists active-moiety UNII 9NDF7JZ4M3.
SPIRIVA is Health Canada DPD DIN 02246793 from NOC 803. HANDIHALER is the device qualifier on the ANDS reference.
NOC 8664 lists GADOVIST 1.0 with GADOBUTROL following NAS NOC 1829 for GADOVIST.
RUPALL DPD DINs 02456451 and 02456478 match NAS NOC 18290. RID submission 186488 records the same approval date.
Lanreotide acetate is a synthetic peptide. Pharmaceutical-class sensitivity retains it.
NOC 16640 and RID submission 139413 link JINARC to the same moiety as SAMSCA NAS NOC 12536.
NOC 17142 and DPD DIN 02444038 document MIFEGYMISO. ANDS NOC 35907 spells the reference MEFEGYMISO and names the same full two-ingredient set and reference manufacturer.
